newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SBC shares rise in pre-bourse on shake-up.
newsitem.headline: SBC shares rise in pre-bourse on shake-up.

text.p: Swiss Bank Corp shares rose nearly 1.5 percent in pre-bourse trade as dealers hailed the bank's radical restructuring and changes in provisioning.
Shares were quoted at 239.50/240.50 Swiss francs, up from the close at 236.75. In contrast, other banks were slightly easier.
"At first glance this looks tremendous," one dealer said of the restructuring that will consolidate the bank's domestic operations and change the way it makes provisions.
"This was a very clever move psychologically," another dealer said. -- Zurich newsroom +41 1 631 7340
